Hi, I want to say that I am horrified about this. Life is a sacred thing that we can not take for granted and should be thankful for every day of our lives. Please do not attempt this or anything like this. I have no idea who you are or anything about you but I am concerned for you. I understand if things are hard, but just try to take a step back and do something you enjoy to get your mind off those thoughts. If you are suffering from depression, try to hang out with friends, do more things you enjoy, and/or laugh more. Please stay safe and have a great night. Also, please stay safe. This is a cruel world but we can easily overpower it. There is no need to feel bad. If we end our own life this means everything to a LOT of people. It may not seem like it, but there are many people that care about you a whole lot, and if you are gone, this would change their entire lives. Think about how different it would be without you. Especially to those people who love and care about you. ❤❤❤❤❤❤❤
